skill.name: caveman-stats
skill.description: Show Claude Code session token usage and estimated savings from the current session log. The skill documents a hook-driven /caveman-stats workflow.
skill.summary: Reports current session tokens and estimated savings for the Caveman workflow.
skill.author: juliusbrussee

content.value_statement: Claude Code users need reliable token receipts without asking the model to estimate usage. This skill documents a hook-based command that reports session tokens and estimated savings from the local log.
actual_capabilities: Documents the /caveman-stats command for viewing current session token receipts.
Explains that token counts come from the Claude Code JSONL session log.
Describes input tokens, output tokens, baseline tokens, saved tokens, and saved percentage.
States that output is supplied by the caveman-mode-tracker hook instead of model estimation.
Notes a lifetime-savings suffix file for a statusline badge.
limitations: The package only contains documentation; hook implementation files are not included in this skill directory.
Savings are estimates against a non-caveman baseline, not verified billing data.
It depends on the Caveman hook environment and Claude Code session logs.
It does not provide analytics beyond the current session and the lifetime suffix described in the README.

use_cases.title: Review Session Cost
use_cases.description: Check real token usage after a Claude Code work session and see the estimated Caveman savings.

use_cases.title: Track Team Efficiency
use_cases.description: Use receipt-style stats to discuss whether Caveman workflows reduce output tokens across similar tasks.

use_cases.title: Validate Hook Output
use_cases.description: Confirm that the /caveman-stats hook returns the expected token fields and statusline suffix behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Show Session Stats
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for the default token receipt.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Savings
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /caveman-stats, then summarize input, output, baseline, and saved percentage.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Workflow Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /caveman-stats to capture the current session, then explain how the savings affect this task's token budget.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of token budget impact.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Token Efficiency
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /caveman-stats and review whether the current session has unusual output volume or low savings. Recommend one workflow adjustment.

output_examples.input: User runs /caveman-stats during a Claude Code session.
output_examples.output: A receipt-style summary shows session turns, input tokens, Caveman output tokens, baseline output estimate, and saved tokens.

output_examples.input: User asks for a short explanation after viewing the stats.
output_examples.output: The response explains whether the session used fewer output tokens than the estimated baseline.

output_examples.input: Maintainer checks the statusline behavior after several sessions.
output_examples.output: The workflow describes a lifetime-savings suffix that can appear in a statusline badge.

best_practices: Run the command after meaningful work, when the session has enough turns to measure.
Treat savings as directional estimates, not billing records.
Keep Caveman hooks installed and versioned with the workflow that consumes the skill.
anti_patterns: Using the numbers as exact invoice data.
Running the command in an environment without the required hook.
Comparing sessions with very different task scope as if they are equivalent.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate tokens with AI?
faq.answer: No. The README states that numbers come from the local Claude Code session log, not model estimation.

faq.question: How do I invoke it?
faq.answer: Use /caveman-stats in the Caveman hook environment described by the skill.

faq.question: Are the savings exact?
faq.answer: No. The token usage is presented as real session data, but baseline savings are estimates.

faq.question: Does it work without the hook files?
faq.answer: The scanned skill contains README.md and SKILL.md. The hook implementation is referenced but not included here.

faq.question: Can Codex use this marketplace entry?
faq.answer: The entry includes Codex metadata, but the documented command targets Claude Code session logs and hooks.

faq.question: What does the statusline badge show?
faq.answer: The README says each run writes a lifetime-savings suffix used by the statusline badge.
